newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market afternoon report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market afternoon report.

text.p: Swiss franc bonds ended steady to slightly easier in slack trading with dealers attributing thin trading volume to the market's closure on Friday in connection with the Swiss national holiday.
Prior to U.S. economic data -- second quarter GDP, jobless claims and National Association of Purchasing Mangement (NAPM) index -- traders were also sidelined.

But an initial uptick in U.S. Treasuries after the data did not manage to pull up Swiss bonds, although a later declined put some pressure on Bund futures, the Conf-contract and federal bonds, dealers said.
Euro Swiss francs up six at 98.47.
